title: Report Re Leonid Shaidouroff

page_data.en:

G. 25,000-14

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Special Branch
File No. 991/2
C. & S. B. REGISTER
Date August 4. 19 32.

Subject (in full) Leonid Shaidouroff.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名]

With reference to the attached memo on the subject
of Leonid Shaidouroff of "B" Company, S.V.C., inquiries show
that he is Russian, and according to the records of the Russian
Emigrants' Committee, he was born in Harbin in 1916, but it is
believed however, that he is much older and is said to be 19
years of age.

Shaidouroff was educated in the Soviet Middle School
in Habarovsk and later in the Public School in Shanghai.
He arrived in Shanghai about three years ago from Habarovsk,
U.S.S.R., via Harbin. His father is employed with the
"Gosbank" (Soviet Government Bank) in Habarovsk; and his elder
brother, who resides with his father, is reported to be a member
of "Komosomol" (Communist Youth Organization). L. Shaidouroff
has the reputation among his fellow schoolmates and members
of "B" Company as being a Soviet sympathizer. He is frequently
seen in the company of suspicious looking young men visiting
local cabarets and restaurants, and is known to be always
well supplied with funds.

In December 1930, Shaidouroff stowed away on the s.s.
"Empress of Japan" with intention of proceeding to America but
was discovered in Hongkong, where he was arrested and after being
detained for a short period, was deported to Shanghai.

L. Shaidouroff is at present unemployed and resides
with his mother Anna Fedorovna Shaidouroff at Room No.5,
Central Arcade, No.49 Nanking Road. The mother claims to be of
Italian extraction although she does not speak that language.
According to our information, she is a native of Blagoveshensk,
Siberia, and arrived in Shanghai from Habarovsk, U.S.S.R. in 1926.
Sometime after arrival, she opened a massage and beauty studio

报告
特别支部
档案编号 991/2
刑事与特别支部登记簿
日期：1932年8月4日。

主题（全称）：列昂尼德·沙伊杜罗夫（Leonid Shaidouroff）。

制作人：D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）。转呈人：[签名]

关于附函所述上海万国商团（S.V.C.）“B”连列昂尼德·沙伊杜罗夫一事，经查证，其为俄国人。根据俄国侨民委员会的记录，他于1916年出生于哈尔滨，但据信其实际年龄要大得多，另有说法称其为19岁。

沙伊杜罗夫曾在苏联哈巴罗夫斯克（Habarovsk）的苏联中学接受教育，后在上海的公立学校就读。他约于三年前从苏联哈巴罗夫斯克经哈尔滨抵达上海。其父受雇于哈巴罗夫斯克的“戈斯班克”（Gosbank，即苏联政府银行）；与其父同住的兄长据报为“科莫索尔”（Komosomol，即共产主义青年团）成员。L. 沙伊杜罗夫在其同学及“B”连成员中享有亲苏分子的声誉。人们经常看到他与一些形迹可疑的年轻男子一同出入当地的歌舞厅和餐馆，且众所周知他手头总是资金充裕。

1930年12月，沙伊杜罗夫偷渡登上“日本皇后号”（s.s. "Empress of Japan"）轮船，意图前往美国，但在香港被发现，随即被捕，在被短暂拘留后，被驱逐至上海。

L. 沙伊杜罗夫目前无业，与其母安娜·费奥多罗芙娜·沙伊杜罗娃（Anna Fedorovna Shaidouroff）同住于南京路49号中央商场5号房间。其母声称有意大利血统，但她并不会说意大利语。根据我方掌握的信息，她系西伯利亚布拉戈维申斯克（Blagoveshensk）人，于1926年从苏联哈巴罗夫斯克抵达上海。抵沪后不久，她开设了一家按摩美容室
